name: browser-use
headline: battery cell extraction skill automation
short_description: A Claude Skill that extracts Li-ion battery cell specifications from supplier PDF datasheets, converts them to structured JSON, and exports the data to Google Sheets.
author: thinkwithyili

sections.overview:
Battery Cell Extraction is a Claude Skill that automates the extraction and standardization of Li-ion battery cell specifications from supplier PDF datasheets. The workflow processes unstructured PDF data through Claude's extraction engine, producing structured JSON output that captures key cell parameters in a normalized format. That JSON can then be exported to Google Sheets for database building and analysis such as Ragone plots. The skill is designed for engineers, researchers, and procurement teams who need to aggregate and compare battery cell data from multiple suppliers without manual data entry.
Extracting battery cell specifications from supplier PDF datasheets automatically
Building a structured Google Sheets database of Li-ion cell parameters
Standardizing and normalizing battery spec data from multiple suppliers
Preparing structured cell data for Ragone plot analysis
